title: Grilled Salmon Kebabs
description: A simple and delicious recipe for grilled salmon kebabs, perfect for a quick and healthy meal. This dish is gluten-free and can be prepared in under 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: Russian River Smoked Paprika
ingredients.notes: Add a smoky flavor to your kebabs

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice
ingredients.notes: Add a squeeze of fresh lemon juice for brightness

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality olive oil for grilling

ingredients.name: Garlic (minced)
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds depth to the dish

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for best flavor

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground black pepper adds a nice kick

ingredients.name: Fresh Cilantro (chopped)
ingredients.notes: Chopped cilantro adds a fresh flavor

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together smoked paprika, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the fish fillets to the marinade and coat evenly.
Thread the marinated fish onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Drizzle olive oil over the kebabs and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
